status_definitions.READY: Official/approved source is identified and sufficient to begin normalization.

status_definitions.PRIVATE_ON_DEMAND: Information belongs to private/restricted due-diligence workflow.
status_definitions.GAP: No sufficient approved source is currently registered.

Annex II materializer is validated end-to-end: official PDF snapshot + SHA-256 + strict Codlog/SQ/vm2t parser produced 184,281 unique keys with zero conflicts. PGV land-unit value is an input to valuation and must not be presented as assessed value or IPTU.

rows.notes: Official São Paulo ITBI transparency workbooks are materialized into a privacy-safe SQLite index keyed by 11-digit SQL. Public fields include transaction values/date/nature, VVR, tax base, financing, registry office/matrícula, SQL status, frontage, ideal fraction, land/built area, use, pattern and ACC.
